page_title: LEV 2-4 DOR | Bayer Leverkusen v Dortmund 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+2' 2 - 4 Goal! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Florian Wirtz and easily beat the keeper with a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 2:4.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A goal, which was scored by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen), was disallowed due to offside.

88' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Gregor Kobel is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
87' Substitution. Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) on for Julian Brandt.
87' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Yan Couto (Dortmund) replaces Julian Ryerson.
86' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
84' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
82' Substitution. Pascal Gross makes way for Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
82' The cross into the penalty area from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
81' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
80' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
80' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) for Piero Hincapie.
78' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Granit Xhaka and he is replaced by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen).
77' 1 - 4 Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Karim Adeyemi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Emre Can (Dortmund).
73' 1 - 3 Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets under the crossbar.
72' A snap shot by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Lukas Hradecky produces a good save to thwart him.
72' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
71' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
70' The resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared.
70' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
67' The referee blows for a cooling break.
67' It's time for a substitution. Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on in place of Robert Andrich.
66' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
65' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
59' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Amine Adli is replaced by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen).
59' Substitution. Nathan Tella will be replaced by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen).
56' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
55' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) takes it short.
54' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the left post.
52' Half-chance! Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
51' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
48' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
46' Niko Kovac makes a half-time substitution. Marcel Sabitzer comes on in place of Felix Nmecha (Dortmund).
46' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+4' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Gregor Kobel leaps like a salmon to deny him. Bayer Leverkusen force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+3' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
45+2' This is a yellow card! Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
43' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Pascal Gross provided an assist for the goal.

41' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Gregor Kobel makes a great save to stop his effort.
40' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
39' A pass by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
33' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Karim Adeyemi tees up Julian Brandt (Dortmund) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Lukas Hradecky.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Florian Wirtz, then sends ball into the top left corner. 1:0.
29' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.

28' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Gregor Kobel guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
27' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
27' That's unlucky! Pascal Gross (Dortmund) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
24' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
24' The linesman signals that Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
23' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
22' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Bayer Leverkusen, play can continue.
20' Referee Deniz Aytekin makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bayer Leverkusen. Let’s see what happens!
19' A player from Dortmund brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a penalty!
18' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.
17' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
15' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
14' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
12' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Gregor Kobel easily deals with the threat.
10' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

9' A long pass finds Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies low towards the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel reacts well to make a good save.
8' The resulting corner from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

8' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner.
7' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
6' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Deniz Aytekin signals. Bayer Leverkusen will take a free kick near the side line.
5' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
4' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the bar!
Dortmund will kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
